description: Defines a PHP interface for stream wrapper implementations in Drupal, specifying methods for directory handling, file operations, stream management, and metadata.

classes.name: PhpStreamWrapperInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface defining methods for custom stream wrappers in Drupal, covering directory, file, stream, and metadata operations.

methods.name: dir_closedir
methods.description: Closes a directory handle, releasing resources.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory handle for a given path with options.

methods.name: dir_readdir
methods.description: Reads the next entry from a directory handle.

methods.name: dir_rewinddir
methods.description: Rewinds the directory handle to the first entry.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path with mode and options.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory from one path to another.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying stream resource for select() operations.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream and releases resources.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Flushes cached data to the underlying storage.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Applies or releases an advisory lock on the stream.

methods.name: stream_metadata
methods.description: Sets metadata (e.g., permissions, ownership) on the stream.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a file or URL stream with specified mode and options.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_set_option
methods.description: Sets options on the stream, such as blocking mode or timeouts.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Retrieves information about the stream resource.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_truncate
methods.description: Truncates the stream to a specified size.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file at the specified path.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file or URL.
